rationale: Irrelevance rewards declining to call a tool and is maximised by an always-refuse model. Pairing it with Multiple (AST), which requires calling, makes an always-decline model score ~22 instead of looking like a 97.5% model.
caveat: Non-Live Overall Acc is intentionally not used: only some categories were run, so unscored categories contribute zero and make that column meaningless.
verdict: Best prose-uncensoring LoRA to date (6/20 refused vs v1 17/20) and near-full recovery of v5 tool-calling collapse, but combined 89.90 still below v1 93.15.
